# MyMegaCalculator

## Description
MyMegaCalculator.com is a free, privacy-first online platform offering instant, high-precision calculators and conversion tools. All calculations run entirely client-side in the user's browser using JavaScript — no personal data, inputs, or results are stored, logged, or transmitted to any server. The site serves homeowners, DIY enthusiasts, fitness practitioners, students, borrowers, and anyone needing quick, reliable math calculations without registration or ads.

## Key Features
- 100% free calculators with no sign-up required
- Client-side JavaScript processing; calculator inputs are not stored. General site analytics may be used as described in the privacy policy.
- Mobile-friendly, responsive design
- Comprehensive categories: Home Improvement (Tile, Square Footage, Paint), Health & Fitness (BMI, Calorie / TDEE), Finance (Loan / Mortgage), Everyday Math & Conversions (Percentage, Age, Weight, Feet to CM)
- Multi-language support: English and Arabic (ar/)
- Hand-coded calculators tested against known mathematical and medical standards
- Educational blog with practical math guides

## Target Audience
Homeowners, DIY enthusiasts, students, fitness enthusiasts, borrowers, contractors, and everyday users needing quick, dependable math solutions.

## Content Policy
All calculator tools and blog content are original, manually created by the founder, and regularly reviewed for accuracy. The site does not use AI-generated calculator logic; all formulas are verified against standard mathematical and scientific references.
